description: This file defines a class 'WikiDiff3' implementing a diff algorithm based on Myers' and LCS algorithms, along with auxiliary classes and functions for computing differences between sequences of tokens or lines. It appears to be part of a diff/patching functionality within a project.

classes.name: WikiDiff3
classes.description: A class implementing a sequence diff algorithm based on Myers' and LCS techniques, supporting range compression and heuristics to handle large sequences efficiently.

classes.name: RangeDifference
classes.description: A class representing a range of differences in the diff output, used to specify spans of changed content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for WikiDiff3, sets limits for diff calculation.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Computes the differences between two arrays of tokens or lines, storing the diff information internally.

methods.name: diff_range
methods.description: Performs diff on given ranges of lines and returns an array of RangeDifference objects outlining changed spans.

methods.name: getLcsLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the Longest Common Subsequence, with heuristic correction if used.
